$comment: SUPABASE-TABLE-TYPING-1A — repositories whose TABLE access has been migrated
to the generated Database types. Listing a file here opts it into
scripts/ci/typed-db-guard.mjs, which fails if it ever drifts back to the
untyped client, reintroduces a handwritten table-row duplicate, or reaches
for `as any` / `as unknown as`.
This is a MIGRATION ledger, not an allowlist: the repo-wide ban arrives when
the list covers every repository and repositories/supabase/typedDb.ts is
deleted. Add a file only once it genuinely routes .from() through asTypedDb.
Batch 1A scope: account billing + entitlement state, account lifecycle and
deletion, ownership and membership, and the ledger/usage tables those
repositories write through.
Batch 1B scope: the workflow-run persistence + queue boundary (runs, lifecycle, queue, diagnostics), including decision-driving trigger_event validation.
Batch 1C scope: the analytics persistence boundary — saved dashboards, the
source-snapshot cache, and the billing-shadow comparison ledger.
repositories/analytics/queries.ts is INTENTIONALLY not listed: it performs no
table access at all (one .rpc() call), which by the 1A design stays on the
untyped client guarded by RpcArgs/RpcRows + rpc-signature-guard.mjs. Listing it
would fail the check, because the contract of an entry is that the file routes
.from() through asTypedDb.
Batch 1D scope: the workflow definition + lifecycle persistence family —
workflows and workflow_revisions, trash, folders, checkpoints, and templates
with their usage ledger. Six tables, including three decision-driving
definition columns validated through the authoritative workflow/template
contracts rather than cast.
